UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; cd '{{$FullRootDir}}'; try { $TAG = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/v0.9.0/nightly-tag.txt').Trim() } catch { $TAG = 'b12277' }; if (-not $TAG -or $TAG.Length -lt 2) { $TAG = 'b12277' }; $ZIP = \"llama-$TAG-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip\"; Write-Host \"Downloading llama.cpp $TAG...\"; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri \"https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/$TAG/$ZIP\" -OutFile $ZIP; Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP -DestinationPath . -Force; Remove-Item $ZIP -Force"

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; TAG=$(curl -sL https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/v0.9.0/nightly-tag.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n[:space:]'); if [ -z \"$TAG\" ] || [ ${#TAG} -lt 2 ]; then TAG=\"b12277\"; fi; TAR=\"llama-${TAG}-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz\"; echo \"Downloading llama.cpp release $TAG...\"; curl -sL \"https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/${TAG}/${TAR}\" -o \"${TAR}\"; if [ -f \"${TAR}\" ] && [ -s \"${TAR}\" ]; then tar -xzf \"${TAR}\" --strip-components=1 2>/dev/null || tar -xzf \"${TAR}\"; rm -f \"${TAR}\"; fi; if [ -d llama-b* ]; then cp -rn llama-b*/* . 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf llama-b*; fi; chmod +x llama-server llama-cli llama-bench 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libgomp.so.1 ] && [ ! -f libgomp.so.1 ]; then cp -a /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libgomp.so.1* . 2>/dev/null || true; fi"
